releaseNotes:
1. Universal LILO (Line-In / Line-Out) Feeder Route Engine: Complete architectural implementation of intermediate substation loop routes (A-End -> Main Before Station -> Station Entry -> Loop IN -> Loop Peak -> Loop OUT -> Station Exit -> Main Continuation -> B-End). Eliminates 1-tower collapse bug, prevents zero-length duplicate transitions, and seamlessly supports same or independent entry/exit towers.
2. LILO Visual Badges & UI: Route sequence verification displays distinct visual indicators for Main Route, Loop IN, Loop OUT, and Main Route Continuation with live cumulative chainage.
3. Universal Fault Inspection Integration: Real-time mapping of fault distances across intermediate station loops in forward and reverse reference directions with accurate bracketing tower detection.
4. Standardized Crossing Verification & Editor: Unified single full-screen editor across Map popups and Crossings Abstract with CEA compliance verification.

previousStableRelease.releaseNotes:
1. Universal Feeder Route Configuration Engine: Complete architecture supporting normal continuous, return/loop, intermediate stations (e.g. Achalpuram), branches, and multiple stations. Universal geodesic chainage calculation and sequence verification.
2. Standardized Crossing Verification & Editor: Unified single editor (CrossingDetailScreen) for both map popups and crossings abstract. Direct in-situ full-screen editing with 5 approved categories (NH, SH, River, Railway, Power Line), measured clearance input, and dynamic CEA statutory minimum compliance badges.
3. Multi-File Batch Import Fix: Resolved Target Section dropdown text overflow on narrow displays.
4. OTA Application Identity Isolation: Enforced strict applicationId validation preventing unintended cross-repo updates.
